meta.title: Covenant Land & Proposed Holdings
meta.note: Non-ship structures — land holdings and the laboratories built within them. 'Proposed' entries are planned and speced but not yet built; see the linked Storyteller thread for the ruling and the funding plan.

land.name: Nóatún
land.location: Ránargarðr — a seaside harbour holding on the Isle of Man
land.meaning: “Place of Ships” / “Ship Enclosure”, after Njord's seaside hall
land.description: The covenant's first permanent land base: a manor Valdemar is assembling on the Isle of Man for the covenant to Winter in, when sailing, raiding, and trading are hardest. The whole seaside harbour holding is Ránargarðr (“Rán's Garden”), likely to give its name to the village that grows up around the hall. Nóatún is the main hall where the coven Winters; Valdemar's own hall, Undrahöll, houses his laboratory and his and Rán's living quarters.

buildings.name: Nóatún
buildings.role: Main hall — where the coven Winters

buildings.name: Undrahöll — “Hall of Wonders”
buildings.role: Valdemar's hall: his laboratory plus living quarters for him and Rán, the living space kept separate from the lab for Safety

land.funding: Construction (100£) and yearly upkeep are funded through the summer and fall raiding and trading seasons, booked in the covenant ledger; the build seasons are held until the laboratory specs are locked.

labs.name: Undrahöll Laboratory
labs.structure: A modified Viking longhouse — solid stone walls, proper chimneys for ventilation, and windows — inside the hall Undrahöll at Nóatún (Ránargarðr, Isle of Man).
labs.constructionCost: 100£ (100 lab points × ½£/point = 50£, doubled by Superior Construction) — the same points total that sets the Upkeep-4 maintenance below
labs.maintenance: Upkeep 4 = 100 points → ~5£/yr at ≤1 season (Valdemar's Winter-only use), 10£ at two seasons, 15£ at 3–4.
labs.specialties:
Spells +3 (Antechamber)

Items +3 (Forge, Running Water, Superior Tools)

Rego +1 (Dedicated Building) — the player may point this at a rune instead

Aquam +1 (Idyllic Surroundings, seaside) — may instead be Laguz, the water-rune
labs.features: Minor Structures: Extensive Stores, Gallery, Spacious, Well Insulated · Greater Feature: Antechamber · Lesser Features: Forge, Running Water · Free virtues: Dedicated Building, Grand Entrance, Idyllic Surroundings, Superior Construction, Guard, Superior Equipment, Superior Tools · Flaw: Empty ×2 (holding 4 points in reserve for future Refinement)
labs.notes: Viktir rune-workings function as spells, so learning a rune-effect is the Spells activity (+4 with Antechamber & General Quality) and imbuing a rune into an object is the Items activity (+4). Aesthetics +11 reads as a ~55-point reputation as a Rune Master. Refinement is capped at Valdemar's Magic Theory (3) and rises with study. Full player notes and rulings live in the t079 dossier.
